messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — kicking off a targeted attestation for admin entitlements that touch KMS keys in Dedicated. Want to catch any overbroad bindings before Q2 audits.
jonathan: SGTM. scope? all Dedicated projects or just cross-account roles?
samir: recommend starting with cross-account and any role with kms:Decrypt/kms:Encrypt or '*' on keys. smaller blast radius and most likely accidental.
maria: exactly. scope = Dedicated clusters + any service account with key access in prod namespaces. sample size ~50 identities (owners, svcaccts, roles). deadline for attestations: 1 week.
lee: can we auto-gather evidence? owner emails, last-used timestamp from KMS logs, and recent key-usage traces would help.
maria: yes — please pull: owner, iam bindings, lastKeyUsage (cloudtrail/logs), and recent token-use from auth logs. I'll send the attestation template.
access-bot: Automated report ready: 12 identities with wide KMS bindings; 3 svcaccts show kms:Decrypt from two regions. Link: https://redwood-internal/reports/2312349876-attest .
jonathan: sharing a quick query that helped me find cross-project bindings (GCP example):
```
gcloud asset search-all-iam-policies --scope=organizations/123456789 --query="policy:roles/cloudkms* OR bindings.role:roles/cloudkms*" --format=json
```
samir: for AWS IAM, this helped spot resource-level wildcards:
```
aws iam generate-service-last-accessed-details --arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-dedicated-admin
aws iam get-service-last-accessed-details --job-id <id>
```
maria: good. action items: (1) lee — attach lastKeyUsage and recent-auth snippets to the report (2) jonathan — draft attestation email + form for owners (3) samir — triage the 3 svcaccts with cross-region decrypt and propose least-priv adjustments.
lee: will add key usage from the past 90d and a short how-to for owners to prove need. ETA EOD today.
jonathan: draft email ready, linking the attestation form and remediation playbook. will ping owners with required artifacts: justification, workload flow diagram, and timeframe.
samir: triage note — one svcacct is used by an old rollout job that still lives in staging; propose rotating key usage to a staging-only key and removing prod decrypt perms.
maria: +1. also flag any identities with no listed owner as "unattested" and queue for forced removal after 30d if no owner claims.
access-bot: Reminder set: follow-up checks in 14 days.
maria: if anyone sees a suspicious spike in KMS decrypts while we notify owners, call it out here immediately. we may pause automated jobs if needed.
jonathan: adding a small rollback snippet for infra owners in case we need to emergency-remove a binding:
```
# AWS example to remove key policy statement
aws kms put-key-policy --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/abcd --policy file://policy-without-admin.json
```
lee: noted. will keep a snapshot of existing policies before changes.
samir: thanks all — starting the vuln-triage for the 3 svcaccts now. will report back with proposed least-priv policies.
maria: thanks. status update ping in 48h. :thumbsup:
